# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech Job for Entrepreneurship](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and build something meaningful.

## Projects

- [Claude Surf Development Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, integrating Linear tickets and Git workflows.
- [Fantasy IDL Prediction Game](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-fantasy-idl): Live dance competition prediction game with real-time scoring, leaderboards, and technical architecture details.
